root_cause_or_implementation_gap: The real Leads route exposed the history tab boundary but resolved the list from activeLeads and rendered the generic columns, so linked service cases were not represented as historical context. The implementation derives history from the real workspace-scoped lead source, excludes soft-deleted records, classifies won/lost/moved-to-service entries through canonical status and linked-case owners, wires outcome/reason/value/close-period filters, and renders real related-case context while preserving row navigation and the existing archive mutation.

rules: History membership is derived from canonical lead status, sales outcome and linked-case movement semantics; no screenshot record is hardcoded.
Outcome labels, tones, loss reasons and related-case state come from existing domain fields and owners; missing close dates are stated rather than invented.
The reference is used for hierarchy, density and column intent only; current workspace counts and records remain the source of truth.
Soft-delete semantics remain owned by isLeadInTrash and existing archive/restore behavior; no parallel history data model is introduced.
Every visible history control is backed by an existing query, derived filter, navigation owner or existing mutation; dead controls are not accepted.

visible_controls_wired: All visible history controls are backed by real local data, derived filters, existing lead navigation or the existing archive mutation; no unsupported import, restore or fabricated action was added.
